name: Altamount Road

catalysts.name: Mumbai Coastal Road (Marine Drive to Bandra-Worli Sea Link)
Metro Line 3 (Aqua Line) Cuffe Parade - Aarey JVLR, fully operational
Atal Setu (Mumbai Trans Harbour Link, Sewri - Nhava Sheva)

notes: Altamount Road (S.K. Barodawalla Marg) on Cumballa Hill is one of India's most expensive streets and home to Antilia. Lodha Altamount set a national record of Rs 1.6 lakh/sq ft in 2015. Metro Line 3's final Worli-Cuffe Parade stretch was inaugurated on 8 Oct 2025 and opened to the public on 9 Oct 2025.

name: Goregaon East

catalysts.name: Metro Line 7 (Red Line) Andheri East - Dahisar East along Western Express Highway
Goregaon-Mulund Link Road (GMLR) incl. twin tunnels under SGNP
Metro Line 3 (Aqua Line) northern terminus at Aarey JVLR

notes: Metro Lines 2A and 7 were dedicated by PM Modi on 19 Jan 2023, after the first sections opened in April 2022. GMLR's target completion has moved several times: Oct 2028 and Dec 2028 in earlier BMC statements, and Feb 2029 in a Nov 2026 report, with both TBMs now excavating. Square Yards put the Goregaon East average asking price at about Rs 32,800/sq ft in Sep 2026. In Feb 2026 Oberoi sold an 8,570 sq ft Elysian penthouse for Rs 55 crore (about Rs 64,822/sq ft) (https://houssed.com/blog/news/oberoi-realty-goregaon-penthouse-sale-55-crore).

name: Lower Parel

catalysts.name: Worli-Sewri Elevated Connector (incl. new double-decker Elphinstone/Prabhadevi bridge between Lower Parel and Parel)
Mumbai Metro Line 3 (Aqua Line), fully operational
Atal Setu / Mumbai Trans Harbour Link (Sewri to Nhava Sheva)
Mumbai Coastal Road (Marine Drive to Worli / Bandra-Worli Sea Link)

notes: A former mill district (for example the Shrinivas Mills site under Lodha The World Towers) redeveloped into offices and luxury towers along Senapati Bapat Marg. A Homebazaar locality series shows Senapati Bapat Marg asking rates rising from about Rs 30,600/sq ft (2016) to Rs 52,450/sq ft (2025) (https://www.homebazaar.com/lodha-world-towers-lower-parel-274); these are listing data with low confidence. Several Lower Parel towers, including World One and Indiabulls Blu, are marketed as 'Worli'.

name: Mahalaxmi

catalysts.name: Mumbai Metro Line 3 (Aqua Line), fully operational, with a station at Mahalaxmi
Mumbai Coastal Road (Marine Drive to Worli / Bandra-Worli Sea Link)
Atal Setu / Mumbai Trans Harbour Link (Sewri to Nhava Sheva)
Worli-Sewri Elevated Connector

notes: A racecourse-facing luxury pocket around Jacob Circle and Sane Guruji Marg, including Raheja Vivarea and the newer Raheja Modern Vivarea on former Modern Mills land. Portal asking averages for Mahalaxmi range from about Rs 60,600 to 73,000/sq ft in 2026 (Square Yards, Mumbai Property Exchange; low confidence). Mumbai Property Exchange cites a government ready reckoner rate of about Rs 19,800/sq ft carpet (https://www.mumbaipropertyexchange.com/project/vivarea-a-b-c-mahalaxmi-by-k-raheja-corp/3240). The Metro 3 station name is from general line maps and was not separately verified in a fetched source.

name: Malabar Hill / Walkeshwar

catalysts.name: Mumbai Coastal Road (Marine Drive to Worli / Bandra-Worli Sea Link)
Metro Line 3 (Aqua Line) full Cuffe Parade - Aarey JVLR corridor
Atal Setu (Mumbai Trans Harbour Link)

notes: Mumbai's most exclusive residential hill, around Raj Bhavan and Walkeshwar Road. Lodha Malabar sold units at about Rs 1.17-1.45 lakh/sq ft in 2023-25, including the Rs 252 crore Bajaj triplex. In Jan 2026 Lodha bought development rights to another 4.3-acre Malabar / Cumballa Hill parcel for about Rs 106 crore (https://www.freepressjournal.in/mumbai/mumbai-real-estate-news-lodha-developers-acquires-43-acre-malabar-hill-land-development-rights-for-106-crore).

name: Parel

catalysts.name: Sewri-Worli Elevated Connector (Elphinstone double-decker bridge)
Atal Setu (Mumbai Trans Harbour Link) from Sewri
Metro Line 3 (Aqua Line), stations in neighbouring Worli / Dadar

notes: Former mill district redeveloped into high-rise luxury towers and offices; Kalpataru Avana sits behind ITC Grand Central. Square Yards put the Parel locality average asking price at about Rs 46,200/sq ft in Sep 2026. The Sewri-Worli connector links Atal Setu directly to the Worli / Coastal Road side, crossing Parel at Elphinstone.

name: Prabhadevi

catalysts.name: Metro Line 3 (Aqua Line), including a station at Siddhivinayak
Mumbai Coastal Road and Bandra-Worli Sea Link connectors
Sewri-Worli Elevated Connector (incl. double-decker Elphinstone bridge)
Atal Setu (MTHL) via Sewri

notes: Sea-facing pocket between Worli and Dadar; Siddhivinayak Temple is a landmark. The Coastal Road's Prabhadevi connector was still pending when the CM said in early 2025 that it would open 'by February'; no confirmation of its opening was found (https://www.freepressjournal.in/amp/mumbai/mumbai-coastal-road-set-to-open-fully-with-prabhadevi-connector-by-february-says-maharashtra-cm-devendra-fadnavis). The Sewri-Worli connector was about 62% complete in 2025-26 and has slipped from a 2026 target to early 2027.

name: Worli

catalysts.name: Mumbai Coastal Road (Marine Drive to Worli, linked to Bandra-Worli Sea Link)
Mumbai Metro Line 3 (Aqua Line), Cuffe Parade to Aarey, fully open; Worli stretch to Cuffe Parade opened Oct 2025
Worli-Sewri Elevated Connector (links Worli to Atal Setu at Sewri, incl. Elphinstone double-decker bridge)
Atal Setu / Mumbai Trans Harbour Link (Sewri to Nhava Sheva)

notes: Anarock data reported in Dec 2025 put Worli at about Rs 5,500 crore of ultra-luxury deals over two years, making it India's largest ultra-luxury housing market (https://www.business-standard.com/industry/news/worli-leads-indias-ultra-luxury-housing-boom-125120401114_1.html). Premium towers are quoted at Rs 65,000 to over Rs 1 lakh per sq ft. Coastal Road timeline: the southbound arm (Worli to Marine Drive) opened on 11 Mar 2024, the northbound connector to the Sea Link opened in Sep 2024 and Jan 2025, and full opening awaited the Prabhadevi connector, targeted for Feb 2025 (https://theprint.in/india/coastal-road-to-be-fully-open-to-mumbaikars-on-completion-of-prabhadevi-connector-in-feb-fadnavis/2464216/). Worli-Sewri connector: earlier targets were Sep 2026 and end-2026, and a Jul 2026 report says early 2027. No official MMRDA date was found.
